Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer introduced an incorrect claim by surfacing a search-result snippet stating that the Mississippi River meets the Ohio River at St. Louis (from an NPS page about the Mississippi–Missouri confluence). This conflated the confluences (Mississippi–Missouri vs. Mississippi–Ohio). Failing to verify this against authoritative sources could directly mislead the solution away from the correct meeting point at Cairo, Illinois.
